title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $100 on the iRobot Roomba Max 715 robot vacuum
excerpt: Tackle pet hair and tough dirt as well as other messes.
content_html:
SAVE $100: As of Sep. 16, get the iRobot Roomba Max 715 robot vacuum for $599.99 at Amazon, down from its usual price of $699.99. That's a discount of 14%.

Credit: Amazon

$599.99 at Amazon
$699.99 Save $100

Tired of spending time vacuuming your floors to get rid of dirt, debris, and pet hair? You don't have to when robot vacuums exist. It's time to outsource that job so you can go handle other, more important things that you actually want to do.

As of Sep. 16, get the iRobot Roomba Max 715 robot vacuum for $599.99 at Amazon, down from its usual price of $699.99. That's $100 and a discount of 14%.

Mashable Trend Report

This model boasts 30,000Pa of suction with an anti-tangle brush, odor-control Allergenlock bags, and 90 days of hands-free operation so you don't have to handle or get near dirt or pet dander.

It uses dual rubber brushes to get close to the ground, so whether you're cleaning carpet or hard flooring, it can tackle all the jobs you need it to, especially focusing on high-traffic areas.

When its reservoir is full, it can use its AutoEmpty dock to automatically trap and store dust, neutralize odors, and keep everything fresh, sealed away in a bag that only needs to be changed four times a year.

With intelligent navigation, customizable cleaning schedules, and a wide range of features at its disposal, it can tidy up your home in a flash while you can head off to handle other things. If you're ready to stop focusing on tidying up your home on a regular basis, this robot vacuum is a great pick, especially now that it's on sale.
